summary: Every word a player sees about the elements and the ring sport (MatchSetup.info, label, competitor, style, color; the main menu's Tidebreak panel, the HUD and the ring's screens read them here, so no screen hard-codes element text). The sport is Tidebreak (the owner, 2026-10-04). Each element has its on-screen name, the name its competitors go by (Stone, Tide, Ember, Gale: the arts of data/sway/moves.json) and a one-line style taken from the spell design (docs). No word from any show or its sport is used here or on screen (tests/ring/test_player_words.gd).

sport.name: Tidebreak
sport.menu_line: the ring sport: your element against another
sport.line: Two sides on a deck over the water. Knock the other side back through its three zones and off the open end into the water to take the round.

earth.label: Earth
earth.style: slow and heavy: cover, knockback, your own stones thrown back

water.label: Water
water.style: control and staying alive: water drawn from the grates

fire.label: Fire
fire.style: pure offence: the fastest damage, the weakest defence

air.label: Air
air.style: movement and pushing: the most knockback, deflection, little damage

any.label: Any
any.style: an element drawn by lot when the match begins

difficulties.easy: slow to lock, wide of the mark, late to answer your moves
difficulties.normal: a fair match: steady locks, honest aim
difficulties.hard: quick locks, close aim, and your moves answered

lights.noon: a clear midday sun high over the deck
lights.golden: late afternoon: a low warm sun, long shadows
lights.night: under the moon, every lantern and brazier lit
